topPRs.title: Add plugin-gapsense — TCG card arbitrage intelligence
topPRs.author: flowlabassit-lgtm
topPRs.body:
## Plugin: plugin-gapsense **NPM**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/plugin-gapsense **GitHub**: https://github.com/flowlabassit-lgtm/plugin-gapsense ### What it does Real-time TCG card arbitrage intelligence plugin for ElizaOS agents. Scans 8 trading card platforms simultaneously for Pokémon and One Piece price gaps. **Platforms**: Courtyard · Phygital · Renaiss · SNKRDUNK · eBay · TCGPlayer · CardMarket · CollectorCrypt ### Actions | Action | Triggers | Description | |---|---|---| | `GAPSENSE_SCAN` | "scan TCG market", "find card arbitrage" | Market-wide opportunity scan | | `GAPSENSE_CARD` | "check Charizard ex gaps", "find card deals" | Per-card cross-platform lookup | ### Configuration ```json { "plugins": ["plugin-gapsense"], "settings": { "GAPSENSE_API_URL": "https://your-gapsense-server.com" } } ``` ### Checklist - [x] Only `index.json` modified - [x] Valid JSON, alphabetically sorted - [x] NPM package published: `npm view plugin-gapsense` - [x] GitHub repo public: https://github.com/flowlabassit-lgtm/plugin-gapsense - [x] `elizaos-plugins` topic set on repo - [x] `@elizaos/core ^1.0.0` as peerDependency - [x] `elizaos:plugin:1.0.0` pluginType in agentConfig ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added support for the new gapsense plugin, extending platform capabilities.

Greptile Summary

This PR adds `plugin-gapsense` to the ElizaOS plugin registry — a TCG card arbitrage intelligence plugin that scans 8 trading card platforms for Pokémon and One Piece price gaps. The change is minimal and well-formed: one entry added to `index.json` in correct alphabetical order, and a pre-existing missing-newline at EOF is also fixed. - The registry entry `"plugin-gapsense": "github:flowlabassit-lgtm/plugin-gapsense"` is correctly placed alphabetically between `plugin-connections` and `plugin-moltbazaar`. - The unscoped package name pattern is consistent with other entries in the same section (e.g. `plugin-connections`, `plugin-moltbazaar`, `plugin-octav`). - The plugin's architecture routes all data through a user-configured external server (`GAPSENSE_API_URL`). This is a common pattern for third-party service plugins but means availability depends entirely on the operator running their own backend. Downstream users should be aware of this dependency. - JSON is valid and the EOF newline fix is a welcome cleanup.

Confidence Score: 5/5

- This PR is safe to merge — it is a correctly structured, alphabetically sorted single-entry addition to the registry with no JSON errors. - The change is a one-line addition to a flat JSON registry file. Alphabetical ordering is correct, JSON is valid, the unscoped naming pattern matches existing entries, and the pre-existing EOF newline is fixed. No logic, security, or structural issues were found. - No files require special attention.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | index.json | Adds `plugin-gapsense` registry entry in correct alphabetical position among unscoped plugin entries; also fixes a pre-existing missing newline at end of file. |
